children: RNS Number : 1723T  Avon Technologies Plc  03 September 2026
3 September 2026
AVON TECHNOLOGIES PLC
Notice of Strategy Teach-In event
Avon Technologies plc will host a 'Strategy Teach-In' for investors and analysts at Peel Hunt's offices, 100 Liverpool Street, London EC2M 2AT, on Wednesday 7 October 2026 from 2.30pm.
Over the past three years, Avon Technologies has improved operational performance, strengthened returns and developed a Business Improvement System that is embedded across the organisation.
At the Strategy Teach-In, the management team will discuss the next phase of Avon's strategy and how the Group is building on these strong foundations to create long-term value.
The event will be hosted by the Avon executive team and senior leaders from across the business and will include a showcase of the Group's innovative protective technologies.
For further details and to register to attend the event please email: avontechnologies@sodali.com
A webcast of the event will also be available on the day for those unable to attend in person.

About Avon Technologies plc

Avon Technologies plc is a Military and Law Enforcement protective equipment specialist. Our products are trusted to protect over 4 million service personnel and first responders in over 70 markets around the world.

Driven by a culture of continuous improvement, we empower every individual in our organisation to identify opportunities and implement meaningful change. This commitment fuels our innovation and ensures we're constantly advancing our mission: to provide unparalleled protection for those who protect us.
Our business is structured around two Strategic Business Units:
·      Avon Protection - a leading provider of advanced respiratory and integrated protective systems.
·      Team Wendy - a specialist in high-performance ballistic and impact protection helmet systems.
For further information, please visit our website www.avon-technologiesplc.com
